name: @zk-intent-firewall/zk-circuit
description: Noir circuit for zero-knowledge proof of intent: proves that an agent action obeys a committed, hidden policy

scripts.gates: nargo compile --package proof_of_intent --deny-warnings && bb gates -b target/proof_of_intent.json
scripts.verify: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run check:security-path && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:deps && pnpm run fixtures:check && pnpm run execute
